subject: Staggered demo windows + SI split (Azure & GCP listing)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Alice Monroe <alice@saasco.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Initial: Staggered demo windows + SI split (Azure & GCP listing)

Hi team —

Thanks for the quick responses on the marketplace listing. Alice, to keep momentum with SaaSCo and the Azure/GCP joint listing, I want to propose a staggered demo approach so we can: 
- Run a 25-minute product walk-through aimed at procurement & PMs (APAC-friendly time), then
- Follow with a 35-minute technical deep-dive for the SI (multi-region, later window).

This avoids a single marathon call and lets the SI prep environment window match their availability. Proposed slots (all shown in UTC):
- Option A: 2026-10-12 02:00–03:00 UTC (APAC morning, EMEA late evening)
- Option B: 2026-10-12 08:00–09:00 UTC (EMEA afternoon, US early morning)
- Option C: 2026-10-13 14:00–15:30 UTC (US-friendly; split into 25 + 35)

Vanessa / Karthik — can you confirm which option aligns with the Azure SI runbook and any required infra windows?
Alice / SaaSCo — which slot looks best for your exec + product attendees?

Attaching a short runbook draft for the dual-window flow (Runbook_v2.pdf). I will publish a .ics once we lock the windows.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partner GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Alice Monroe <alice@saasco.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Staggered demo windows + SI split (Azure & GCP listing)

Kim — thanks. Quick notes from partner ops: 
- Azure SI (Tom) has a 30-min technical window requirement and prefers morning APAC (starts at 03:30 UTC).
- If we go with Option A, we should make the technical deep-dive optional for APAC folks and record it for EMEA/US.

Two asks: please loop the SI technical lead (Tom Becker) and mark a soft backup slot +30m after each window to catch overruns.

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Rajesh Nair <raj@cloudline.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Alice Monroe <alice@saasco.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T20:34:00+05:30
Subject: Re: Initial: Staggered demo windows + SI split (Azure & GCP listing)

Thanks for including Cloudline. A couple of constraints from our side: 
- Our lead architect (Tom) is traveling Oct 12–13 and cannot do late-UTC slots. We can support an APAC-morning technical window on Oct 12 between 02:30–04:00 UTC.
- We prefer the technical segment to include: 1) perf baseline (15m), 2) integration touchpoints (10m), 3) Q&A (5–10m).

If Option A is the best fit, can we compress the business walkthrough to 20 minutes and reserve a hard 40-minute block for technical follow-up? I uploaded a lightweight runbook appendix to your Drive link.

Rajesh Nair
Head of Systems Engineering
Cloudline Solutions
Attachment: Runbook_appendix_Cloudline.pdf

On 2026-10-01T10:02:00-07:00 Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com> wrote:

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Rajesh Nair <raj@cloudline.io>, Alice Monroe <alice@saasco.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:12:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Staggered demo windows + SI split (Azure & GCP listing)

Team — small scheduling update from the Azure SI side (Tom looped me):
- Tom can make the APAC-friendly morning on Oct 12 but asked for a 45-minute technical block to include a short perf run. That pushes overall time slightly.
- We have two options operationally:
  1) Keep Option A, shift the technical block to 02:15–03:00 UTC (45m), compress business walkthrough to 20m (01:50–02:10 UTC). Backup +30m after technical block.
  2) Move full session to Option C (Oct 13 US-friendly) and run both segments in one extended 75-minute slot (less ideal for APAC attendees).

From an infra perspective, if we split windows we should: 
- Publish two calendar invites with clear titles: 
  * "SaaSCo — Exec Walkthrough (25m)"
  * "SaaSCo — Technical Deep-dive (45m) — Cloudline / Azure SI"
- Add a short pre-call checklist and a post-call rollback note in the runbook. I added the checklist to the Drive doc.

Related: HubSpot shows deal HUB-78521 as green; if we pick Option A I recommend offering a 14-day access token to Cloudline for a pre-demo test environment.

Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rajesh Nair <raj@cloudline.io>, Alice Monroe <alice@saasco.com>, Tom Becker <tom@azure-si.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T13:45:00+01:00
Subject: Final: Confirmed windows + calendar invites (two invites attached)

Thanks everyone — based on constraints and the SI ask, we will land Option A with minor adjustments. Final plan (UTC):
- Exec Walkthrough (20m): 2026-10-12 01:50–02:10 UTC — attendees: SaaSCo execs, product
- Technical Deep-dive (45m): 2026-10-12 02:15–03:00 UTC — attendees: Cloudline (Tom), Azure SI tech, Redwood engineers
- Soft buffer: 03:00–03:30 UTC (we'll keep this blocked as an optional overrun hold)

Attachments: Staggered_Schedule.ics (two invites), Runbook_v2.pdf (finalized with pre-call checklist). Please: 
1) Confirm you received the .ics and can accept by EOD tomorrow (Oct 3).
2) Rajesh / Tom — confirm the perf baseline step is feasible on Cloudline infra; Karthik will coordinate the test token if yes.

If we hit any last‑minute conflicts we will flip to Option C and consolidate into one 75-minute session.

Thanks,
Kim
